s: strI, (SAko'styatreti । SAka + iniH .) SAkayuktA BUmiH । yaTA, -- “SakawaH SAkinI gAvo jAlamaspandanaM vanam । anUpaM parvvato rAjA durBikze nava vfttayaH ॥” SakawA DAnyAdivahanadbAreRopajIvyaH । “patraM puzpaM PalaM kandaM nAlaM saMsvedajaM taTA । SAkaM zaqviDamuddizwaM guru vidyAt yaTottaram ॥” iti vEdyoktaSAkayogAt SAkinIgfhavAwikASAkAdyAharaRena । gAvo dugDAdinA । jAlaM matsyAdyAharaRena । aspandanaM svasTAnAdatyAgaH fRAdilABena । vyayADikyanivfttyA ca । vanaM PalapuzpAdyAharaRena । anUpaM bahUdakadeSaH samfRAlaSAlUkAdyAharaRena । parvvato gErikamfdAdyAharaRena । rAjA BEkzAdinA । ityAhrikatattvam ॥ * ॥ durgAyA anucarIviSezaH । yaTA, -- “qAkinI yoginI cEvaKecarI SAkinI taTA । dikzu pUjyA imA devyaH susidDAH PaladAyikAH ॥” iti kAtyAyanIkalpaH ॥ “brahmA vizRuSca rudraSca ISvaraSca sadASivaH । tataH paraSivo devi zawSivAH parikIrttitAH ॥ mUlADAre tu brahmARaM qAkinIsahitaM nyaset ॥ sarvvatraM tryakzarImuktvA vAdisAntaM sabindukam ॥ svADizWAnAKyacakre tu savizRuM rAkiRIM taTA । vAdilAntaM pravinyasya nABO tu maRipUrake ॥ qAdiPAntArRasahitaM rudraYca lAkinIM taTA । anAhate kAdiWAntaM ISvaraM kAkinIM taTA ॥ viSudDAKye mahAcakre zoqaSasvarasaMyutam । sadASivaM SAkinIntu vinyaset pUrvvavattataH ॥ AjYAcakre tu deveSi ha-kza-varRasamanvitam । paraM SivaM brahmarUpaM hAkinIsahitaM nyaset ॥” iti tArAnyAsaBedaH । iti tantrasAraH ॥
v: strI SAkamastyasyAH utpadyatvena ini । 1 SAkaBavanayogyAyAM mUmO gfhavAwikAyAm 2 devIsahacarIBede ca । “qAkinI yoginI cEva KecarI SAkinI taTA । dikzu pUjyA imA devyaH susidDiPaladAyikAH” kAtyA॰ kalpa॰ । kaRWadeSasTe viSudDAKye cakre sTitAyAM 3 devISaktO ca “viSudDAKye mahAcakre zoqaSasvarasaMyute । sadASivaM SAkinIYca vinyaset pUrvavattataH” tantrasA॰ ।
m: शाकिनी (इनी), f. a kind of female demon attendant on Durgā, Pañcat.; Kathās.
शाकिनी f. (cf. under शाकिन्) a field or land planted with vegetables or potherbs, L.
a: शाकिनी — [शाकमस्त्यस्या इनि] 1 A field of vegetables. --2 A kind of female being attendant on Durgā (supposed to be a demon or fairy).

m: 1. शाकिन mfn. (for 2. See col. 3) mighty, RV.
2. शाकिन n. (ifc.; for 1 See col. 2) a field (cf. इक्षु-, ‘a field of sugarcane’, मूल-, शाक-श्˚).
a: शाकिनं — A field; as in शाकशाकिनं.

m: शाकिनिका f. a kind of female demon (= शाकिनी under शाकिन्), Cat.
शाक्की f. N. of one of the five Vibhāṣās or corrupt dialects, Cat.

a: शाक्करः — An ox.

m: शाक्मन् n. (cf. शक्मन्) ‘power’ or ‘help’, RV.
शाकोल m. the Amaranth creeper, L.
शाकोट, शाको˚टक, w.r. for शाख्˚.

शाक्ताभिषेक m. N. of wk.

शाक्तानन्द-तरंगिणी f. N. of wk. compiled for the use of the Śāktas from the Tantras and Purāṇas.

m: शाक्तीक mfn. belonging or relating to a spear, spearing, speared, W.

s: tri, SaktirdevatA asya । (Sakti + “sAsya devatA .” 4 । 2 । 24 । ityaR .) SaktyupAsakaH । asya praSaMsA yaTA, -- “svarge martye ca pAtAle nAsti SAktAt paraH priyaH । sOrARAM gARapatyAnAM vEzRavAnAM taTEva ca ॥ tadante cEva SAktAH syuH kramaSaH kramaSaH priye । SfRu devi varArohe nAsti SAktAt paro janaH ॥ SAkto'pi SaNkaraH sAkzAt paraM brahmasvarUpaBAk । ArADitA yena kAlI tArA triBuvaneSvarI ॥ zoqaSI cEva mAtaNgI CinnA ca galavAmuKI । ArADitA maheSAni sa Sivo nAtra saMSayaH ॥ atigopyaM maheSAni SAktAnAM paramaM padam । yo jAnAti mahImaDye sa Sivo nAtra saMSayaH ॥ brahmAdyarccitapAdAbjaM yo Bajet satataM mudA । sa yAtyacirakAlena muktimandirameva hi । pArvvatIcaraRadvandvaBajanAkiNkaro Bavet । svargaBogaSca mokzaSca SAktAnAM na Bavet kimu ॥ SAktAnAYcEva nindAM ye kurvvanti hi narADamAH । tezAM lohitapAnaM vE kurvvanti BEravIgaRAH ॥ BEravAScEva BEravyaH sadA hiMsanti pAmarAn । SAktAn hiMsanti garjanti nindanti bahujalpakAH ॥ Cinatti tezAM deveSi SirAMsi haravallaBA । SAkteBya uttamo nAsti svarge martye rasAtale ॥ SAktastu SaNkaro jYeyastrinetraScandraSeKaraH । svayaM gaNgADaro BUtvA viharet kzitimaRqale ॥” devIM prati SivavAkyam । “madaMSAScEva ye BUtAste SEvA nAtra saMSayaH । tvadaMSAScEva SAktASca satyaM vE girinandini । bahuvarzasahasrAnte SEvAH SaktiparAyaRAH । SAktA vE SaNkarA devi yasya kasya kulodBavAH ॥ cARqAlA brAhmaRAH SUdrAH kzattriyA vESyasamBavAH । ete SAktA jagadDAtri na manuzyAH kadAcana ॥ paSyanti mAnuzAn loke kevalaM karmmacakzuzA । brAhmaREH kzattriyErvvESyEH SUdrEreva ca jAtiBiH ॥ vAmamArgapraBAveRa karttavyaM japapUjanam । ye SAktA brAhmaRA devi kzattriyA brAhmaRAH smftAH ॥ vESyASca brAhmaRA devi sarvve SUdrASca brAhmaRAH । brAhmaRAH SaNkarAScaRqi trinetrAScandraSeKarAH ॥” iti muRqamAlAtantre 2 । 3 । 4 । 7 pawalAH ॥ * ॥ “SAktA eva dbijAH sarvve na SEvA na ca vEzRavAH । upAsante yato devIM gAyattrIM paramAkzarIm ॥” iti nirvvARatantre 3 pawalaH ॥ SaktyupAsanAnantaramanyopAsananizeDo yaTA, -- “asyAScArADanaM kftvA nAnyasyArADanaM caret । anyasya smaraRAddevi yoginISApamAlaBet ॥” iti ganDarvvatantre 2 pawalaH ॥ * ॥ tasya AByantarasnAnaM yaTA, -- “SAktamAByantarasnAnamuktaM SrIpaYcamImate । snAnaprakAro dviviDo bAhyAByantaraBedataH ॥ AntaraM AnamatyantaM rahasyamapi sAdarAt । kaTayAmi BayaDvastyE caturvvargaPalAptaye ॥ sambittrayamanusftya caraRatrayamaDyataH । sravaskaM saccidAnandapraBAvaM BAvagocaram ॥ vimuktisADanaM puMsAM smaraRAdeva yoginAm । tena plAvitamAtmAnaM BAvayet BayaSAntaye ॥” iti viSvasAratantre 2 pawalaH ॥ * ॥ tasya kuSaviSezo yaTA, -- “tarjjanyA rajataM DAryyaM svarRaM DAryyamanAmayA । eza eva kuSaH SAkte na darBo vanasamBavaH ॥” iti SyAmArahasyam ॥ (SaktimAn । yaTA, fgvede । 7 । 103 । 5 । “vAcaM SAktasyeva vadati SikzamARaH ॥” “SikzamARaH SikzyamARaH SizyaH SAktasyeva SaktimataH Sikzakasya vAcaM yaTA anuvadati tadvat .” iti tadBAzye sAyaRaH ॥)
v: tri॰ SaktirdavatA'sya aR । tantrokte SaktidevatopAsake tasya praSaMsA muRqamAlAta॰ 2 pawale uktA “svarge martye ca pAtAle nAsti SAktAt paraH priyaH । sOrARAM gARapatyAnAM vEzRavAnAM taTEva ca । SEvAnte cEva SAktaSca kramaSaH kramaSaH priye!” “SAktA eva dvijAH marve na SEvA na ca vEzRavAH । upAsate yato devIM gAyatrIM paramAkzarAm” nirvARata॰ 2 pawale । “asyAScArADanaM kftvA nAnyasyArADanaM caret । anyasya smaraRAddevi! yoginI SApamAlaBet” ganGarvata॰ । “tarjanyA rajataM DAryyaM svarRaM DAryyamanAmayA । eza eva kuSaH SAkto na darBo vanasamBavaH” SyAmAra॰ ।
m: शाक्त mfn. (fr. शक्ति) relating to power or energy, relating to the Śakti or divine energy under its female personification, Sarvad.

शाक्त m. a worshipper of that energy (especially as identified with Durgā, wife of Śiva; the Śāktas form one of the principal sects of the Hindūs, their tenets being contained in the Tantras and the ritual enjoined being of two kinds, the impurer called वामाचार, q.v., and the purer दक्षिणाचार, q.v.), RTL. 185 &c.
शाक्त m. a teacher, preceptor, RV. vii, 103, 5
patr. of Parāśara, MBh. (C. शाक्त्र)
शाक्त n. N. of a Sāman (prob. = शाक्त्य, q.v.)
a: शाक्त — a. क्ती f. [शक्तिर्देवताऽस्य अण्.] 1 Relating to power. --2 Relating to Śakti or the female personification of divine energy --क्तः A worshipper of Śakti; (the Śāktas are generally worshippers of Durgā representing the female personification of divine energy, and the ritual enjoined to them is of two kinds, the pure or right-hand ritual दक्षिणाचार, and impure or left-hand ritual वामाचार q.q. v.v.).

m: शाक्त—भाष्य n. N. of wk. by Abhinava-gupta.

शाक्त—सर्वस्व n. N. of wk.
शाक्त—तन्त्र n. N. of Tantra wk.

patr. of Parāśara, MBh.
a: शाक्तेयः, शाक्त्यः — 1 A worshipper of Śakti. --2 N. of Parāśara.

peculiar to the Śāktas, Tantras.
शाक्तिक m. a worshipper of the Śakti (see शाक्त above), MW.
a spearman, ib.
a: शाक्तिकः — 1 A worshipper of Śakti. --2 A spearman, lancer.

m: शाक्त्र and शाक्त्रेय, m. patr. of Parāśara, MBh. (C.; cf. शाक्त, शान्त, ˚तेय).
शाक्त्यायन m. patr. fr. शाक्त्य (also pl.), Saṃskārak.

शाकुण — a. (णी f.) 1 Repentant. --2 Afflicting others (परतापक).

m: शाकुलिक mfn. belonging to fish

शाकुलिक n. a multitude of fish, L.
a: शाकुलिकः — A fisherman.

ominous, portentous, W.

augury, omen, ib.; R.

शाकुन—विचार m. N. of wk.

m: शाकुनेय mfn. relating to birds or omens, MW.
composed or written by Śakuni, Cat.

patr. of the Asura Vṛka, BhP.
a: शाकुनेयः — A small owl.

शाकुनिकायिनी f. a female poulterer (?), Divyāv.

m: शाकुनिक mfn. relating to birds or omens, ominous, W.
शाकुनिक m. a fowler, bird-catcher, Mn.; MBh. &c.
a fisherman, MaitrUp.

m: शाकुनिक—प्रश्न m. N. of wk. on augury.
शाकुनिन् m. a fisherman, VarBṛS. (v.l. शाकुन)
a partic. evil demon, L.
शाकुन्तकीय m. a king of the Śākuntakis, ib.
शाकुन्तकि m. pl. (fr. शकुन्त, or शकुन्तक) N. of a warrior-tribe g. दामन्य्-आदि.

an imaginary kind of Soma, Suśr. (w.r. शांकर)
